ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:0.95 ratio of high-intensity pixels (white scars/tips) to low-intensity pixels (black background pigmentation).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous dark pigmentation across >90% of the fluke area. High-contrast white clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and as linear streaks in the upper-mid sections.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped depression approximately 40 degrees at the vertex, extending significantly into the central fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable large-scale jagged indentation on the right lobe approximately two-thirds from the notch toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature from the notch transitioning to highly irregular, jagged convex sweeps at the outer margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular spots concentrated on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the left lobe upper-mid section and shorter horizontal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches and significant jagged tissue loss on both the left and right lobe trailing edges, indicative of historical physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible presence of attached high-contrast biological material or debris extending from the distal tips of both lobes.
